<thought>To build the retrosynthetic tree I will first locate suitable reaction templates for each of the six disconnections described in the plan:
1. Sulfonamide formation (break S‑N, form S‑Cl).
2. Intramolecular Michael cyclization of a chalcone to a flavanone (break C‑O, form C‑C and C‑O).
3. Aldol/Claisen‑Schmidt condensation to make the chalcone (break C‑C, form C‑C).
4. Electrophilic bromination of an aromatic ring (break C‑H, form C‑Br).
5. Nucleophilic aromatic substitution (SNAr) to attach the piperazine (break C‑X, form C‑N).
6. Carbamate (Boc) formation on the piperazine nitrogen (break C‑O, form C‑O).

I will query the template catalog for each forward reaction to obtain template IDs, then assemble the retrosynthetic JSON tree.
We need to actually call tools to get templates. Let's start with sulfonamide formation.
